Requester asks for independent randomized complex concepts that test the newly reflected visual topic with the attached photograph. The actual envelope provides no named place, palette or pattern. Agent choice: an invented scenic fabric maker in a greenhouse finishes a shade-curtain repair; a narrow crossed line pattern and one small solid tab share a linen carrier, while surface color, weave, background colored light and photographic contrast remain distinguishable. The viewer should first feel the maker's quiet completion, then understand the repaired local exception within a coherent patterned textile. A large workshop bustle alternative would obscure the small tab, and a studio-only material display would weaken the readable reason for touching the cloth; the chosen moment balances portrait presence with carrier legibility. All selected colors, geometry, role, place and camera are synthetic authorial choices, not actual-user definitions, biography or acceptance.

A layered photographic study of local color and pattern shows a complex scene in progress in a botanical greenhouse shadecloth workshop. A woman is portrayed using the supplied photograph as the visible appearance reference: her softly rounded oval face, dark brown eyes, short dark chin-length bob and fine loose fringe remain recognizable. This is an invented working moment. She is a scenic fabric maker preparing a repaired shade curtain for a small greenhouse installation. Her quiet half-smile and easy shoulders lend the portrait a gently inviting presence while attention rests on the just-finished work. A washed linen curtain panel hangs from a plain rail beside her, its lower edge ending at her waist. Her left hand steadies the curtain edge; her right palm smooths its front surface beside the newly sewn tab, fingers resting flat on the cloth. Both elbows bend comfortably in the open space before her torso. The curtain carries the color and pattern study on one continuous, visibly woven surface. Pale butter-yellow linen is the broad ground. Fine indigo-blue vertical lines run at close, even intervals, crossed at right angles by much more widely spaced indigo horizontal rulings. The two sets have similarly narrow line widths and form tall rectangular cells. Crossings are clean and readable across the flat central area, while a shallow fold gently bends the same repeat at the edge. Yellow occupies most of the curtain; the blue remains a small-area linear pattern rather than large color blocks. A single solid scarlet-red replacement tab is stitched into the lower near corner of that same curtain, roughly one hundredth of its visible area. Its color ends at the stitched perimeter. The tab has a plain unpatterned face, its fine linen weave and thread holes visible. A short clipped thread and a closed pair of small sewing scissors on the bench below connect her smoothing gesture with the repair just completed. Her faded olive work apron over a sand-colored blouse and the muted wooden bench stay subordinate to the yellow curtain, blue rulings and small red exception. Overcast doorway light spreads a soft neutral illumination across her face and the curtain, preserving yellow, blue, scarlet and natural skin tones as distinct surface colors. A weak greenish fluorescent tube recedes among damp pots and glass framing in the far background; its faint colored reflection stays in that depth. Gentle print-like contrast preserves the curtain's material texture and color boundaries. The capture camera sits at waist height and looks gently upward along the hanging panel in a medium environmental portrait, including her face, both working hands, the entire curtain and the rail. A natural-perspective lens and sufficient depth of field hold the face, crossings and tab clear. The viewer can read a completed repair being checked before the curtain returns to use.

definitions.principle: These creative definitions guide agent-owned choices within requester meaning, not clinical classifications. Zero/off disables added treatment, never removes explicitly requested content or artistic judgment. Expression levels describe prominence in the whole image; creativity levels describe interpretive freedom. Neither measures exposure percentages, detail quotas, quality scores, or native image-model parameters. Intensity and expression are separate choices; higher intensity does not prescribe a garment, material or expression category. Creativity leaves style, extra props and surreal treatment open to the request and artistic judgment. Emphasis directs only active sensual and fetish axes without changing their intensities. Popular permits familiar appeal without requiring trend search; overt is an available expression, not the mandatory meaning of level three. Choose a coherent expression suited to this particular scene. Sensual and fetish may share the same expressive choice.

choice_descriptions.auto: Let the higher effective intensity lead; equal active intensities share leadership. Add no emphasis when both axes are inactive.
choice_descriptions.sensual_led: Let broad attraction and desire lead, with any active distinctive fascination supporting the expression.

choice_descriptions.fetish_led: Let the distinctive focus of attraction or fascination lead, with any active sensual expression supporting it.

creativity.definition: Freedom to interpret unspecified choices and explore relationships within the request.

levels.0: Realize the request directly, filling only what is needed for a coherent image.
levels.1: Introduce restrained variations close to the requested direction.
levels.2: Actively reinterpret open choices into a coherent authorial direction.
levels.3: Boldly explore unexpected relationships and interpretations while preserving the request's core meaning.

viewer_experience.definition: Expose the detailed viewer-experience review when enabled. Always consider the intended impression in interpreted_intent, even when this additional review is off.

reference_edit_mode.definition: Use the selected reference-edit workflow only within the requester's reference-use scope. Record that scope in the core; a face/hair reference does not lock clothing, body shape or composition and does not prove identity. Off does not discard a supplied reference.

surreal.definition: Added departures from ordinary reality, interpreted broadly across space, scale, causality, materials, and atmosphere, including dreamlike, uncanny, symbolic, and impossible relationships.

trend_layer.definition: Consider the chosen treatment from the initial composition. Refine it later without adding it twice. Off does not remove a treatment explicitly present in the request.
